limitations.quote: I’ll make each pointer advance with its accepted RAM operation and handle wraparound at the configured depth.
limitations.note: The rewrite fixed the inverted RAM read enable but also removed the original one-cycle lag in the Gray pointers, changing when `wfull` and `rempty` assert and deassert; the reference fix preserves that timing.

The test used the DUT’s flags to decide which requests counted and expected immediate Gray-pointer updates, so its ordering and boundary checks could pass without detecting the cycle-by-cycle timing mismatch.
The agent resubmitted the full test harness twice before it ran: the first attempt was blocked by the cleanup command, and the second invoked an unavailable Python executable.
